label: FCP MIS Report Generator
description: Generates monthly management information (MIS) reports for FCP functions. Structures KPIs, alert volumes, investigation outcomes, SAR statistics, and training completion into board-ready reporting.

claudeKnowledge.description: FCP MIS reporting best practices, regulatory expectations for AML management information

guidedInputs.label: Reporting Period
guidedInputs.description: The period covered by this MIS report.

guidedInputs.label: Report Audience
guidedInputs.description: Who is the primary audience for this report?

guidedInputs.label: Raw Data / Statistics
guidedInputs.description: Paste or describe the FCP metrics and data for this period. Include any available figures — the AI will structure and contextualize them.
guidedInputs.placeholder:
e.g.
Alerts generated: 1,247 (prev. month: 1,189)
Alerts cleared: 1,198 (96.1%)
Alerts escalated to investigation: 49
Average clearance time: 2.3 days
SARs filed: 7 (prev. month: 4)
New onboardings: 342; EDD triggered: 28
KYC reviews completed: 89 / 134 due
Training completion: 91%
Screening hits reviewed: 234; true matches: 3...

guidedInputs.label: Prior Period Comparisons
guidedInputs.description: Prior period figures for trend analysis, if not included above.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Last month, Q3 average, or year-to-date figures...

guidedInputs.label: Notable Events or Issues
guidedInputs.description: Any significant events, incidents, regulatory interactions, or operational issues to highlight in the report.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. System outage on 14 Jan caused 48hr delay in screening batch. Regulatory letter received on 8 Jan requesting SAR statistics. New MLRO joined on 1 Feb...

guidedInputs.label: Open Items and Remediation Actions
guidedInputs.description: Outstanding action items, remediation activities, or items carried forward from last period.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. KYC backlog remediation: 45 overdue reviews remain (target: clear by end of Q1). Alert model recalibration scheduled for March...
